Generate AI Agent skills from Cobra CLI applications

Usage:
  cobra-to-skills [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  version     Print the version of cobra-to-skills

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for cobra-to-skills

Use "cobra-to-skills [command] --help" for more information about a command.
